title: Where to Act
summary: Reading is the first step; this is the second. A directory of established organisations working on the two subjects we hold at equal weight — women and animals — across the industries we cover.

organisations.name: Human Rights Watch — Women's Rights
organisations.what: Investigates and reports on women's rights globally, including healthcare and bodily-autonomy restrictions.

organisations.name: UN Women
organisations.what: UN body for gender equality; runs programmes and publishes data on women in crisis contexts.

organisations.name: Amnesty International
organisations.what: Campaigns on human rights including women's rights and bodily autonomy; petitions and urgent actions.

organisations.name: Malala Fund
organisations.what: Works for girls' education, including in Afghanistan where secondary and higher education are banned.

organisations.name: World Animal Protection
organisations.what: Global animal-welfare organisation working on farming, wildlife, and animals in disasters.

organisations.name: FOUR PAWS
organisations.what: International animal-welfare organisation; strong on fur, wool (mulesing), and wild-animal trade.

organisations.name: Cruelty Free International
organisations.what: Works to end animal testing worldwide; runs the Leaping Bunny programme.

organisations.name: Collective Fashion Justice
organisations.what: Connects fashion's harm to both animals and people — a 'total ethics fashion' approach.

organisations.name: Changing Markets Foundation
organisations.what: Investigates greenwashing and corporate environmental claims across sectors.

organisations.name: Fashion Revolution
organisations.what: Global movement for transparency in fashion supply chains — garment-worker rights and environmental impact.
